<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex034042026-11-1311-26-57" status="reviewed">
               <milestone unit="section" n="Incipit (1b1-1b2)"/>
               <pb edRef="inst:4703" n="1b"/> <lb edRef="inst:4703" n="1b1"/> <lg><l>mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad pa ||</l> 
               <l>kun sbyor 'ching pa gcod pa'i de bzhin gshegs ||</l> 
               <l>dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas ||</l> 
               <l>mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal te ||</l> </lg>
               <lg><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bla ma</rs>'i gsung dang gzhung la brten nas su ||</l> 
               <l>dge' sbyong rnams kyi bslab pa ston byed pa'i ||</l> 
               <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4704"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3764">tshig le'ur byas pa rdo rje lta bu yi <lb edRef="inst:4703" n="1b2"/> mtshan nyid</rs> gsal byed ti ka</rs> brtsam par bya |</l></lg> </seg></TEI>
source: 2_034_04_ Chos kyi dbang phyug _ tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam bshad.xml
